title: Night-Owl Release Watchlist — Week of Sep 18
content:
Purpose:
Quick personal prep + running notes for the mid-week release-train sync (night shift). Capturing action items, outstanding blockers, and go/no-go gating owners I want to follow up with before the Friday rollout window.

Meeting logistics:
- Weekly release train sync (async-friendly). I’ll be on the 22:00 PT call — timezone notes below.
- Attendees I expect: Release lead (Marcus), Infra on-call (Priya), Serving runtime lead (Samir), QA (Lena), Product PM (Noah), SRE escalation pool.
- Recording / Transcript: link on Confluence (see linked artifacts) — I’ll add timecodes for decisions.

Pre-reads for this session (skim if short on time):
- QA smoke report (Lena) — acceptance tests for model routing and cache fallthrough.
- Canary policy doc (confluence link above) — verify canary criteria still match rollout plan.
- Infra capacity snapshot (INFRA-317) — confirm reserved GPU pools for dedicated burst.

Top-level go/no-go checklist (personal checklist; owners in parentheses):
1) Critical smoke tests pass in staging (QA) — owner: Lena — expected green by Thu 12:00 PT.
2) Serving KV cache regression < 1% error (serving-runtime) — owner: Samir — verify nightly run.
3) Autoscale and reserved capacity validated for peak – (infra) — owner: Priya — confirm dry-run results.
4) Rollback artifact built and tested (release-engineering) — owner: Marcus — test rollback on canary cluster.
5) Communication runbook ready (comms + customer-success) — owner: Noah + Maya — draft emails and dashboard banners ready.
6) Security/Audit sign-off for private customers scheduled (security) — owner: Aisha — gate open/closed?

Current red/amber/green status (as of 2025-09-18 19:45 PT):
- Smoke tests: amber (2 flaky tests; investigating)
- Cache regression: green (observed slight latency bump but within SLO)
- Autoscale: amber (one config mismatch between staging and canary)
- Rollback: green (rollback artifact exists but not fully exercised on traffic)
- Comms: amber (customer mailing list needs validation)
- Security sign-off: red (one outstanding audit question for private deploy package)

Key risks + quick mitigations:
- Risk: Flaky integration tests in auth flow could block canary validation.
  Mitigation: Run targeted auth smoke against canary subset; if flaky persists, isolate change and proceed with reduced canary footprint. Owner: Lena / Samir.

- Risk: Reserved GPU pool mismatch (staging config vs live) could cause throttling during burst.
  Mitigation: Apply patch to infra autoscale policy and run immediate capacity dry-run; if not fixed, postpone burst and limit concurrency. Owner: Priya.

- Risk: Customer private deployment audit opens a hold.
  Mitigation: Route private-customer traffic to previously certified runtime variant or postpone private customer inclusion in this rollout. Owner: Aisha + Marcus.

Action items (short and personal notes to follow up on during night):
- [ ] 19:50 PT: Ping Lena for latest smoke run artifacts (where the 2 flaky tests occurred). Note: ask for raw logs, not aggregated.
- [ ] 20:15 PT: Confirm canary cohort size with Marcus — I prefer 5% -> ramp to 20% if green at 30m.
- [ ] 20:30 PT: Validate rollback route and make sure monitoring alerting triggers on rollback are enabled (Samir to confirm).
- [ ] 21:00 PT: Quick pass on customer comms draft; annotate places where we must mention fallback policies.
- [ ] 21:30 PT: Sync with Priya to confirm burst capacity DR run is scheduled; get run id and logs.
- [ ] 21:45 PT: If audit question not resolved, prepare public vs private split plan and short notes for execs (Marcus + Aisha).

Decisions to finalize before Friday (short notes):
- Canary ramp cadence: 5% -> 20% after 30m -> 50% after 3h if no regressions. (need sign-off from Marcus)
- Feature gating for private customers: opt-out by default until audit closed; opt-in via manual toggle. (tentative)
- Night-mode on-call rotation: Marcus will own 22:00–02:00 PT; Priya will be backup. Confirmed?

Notes to self / TODO during call:
- Timezone conversions: 22:00 PT = 01:00 ET (next day) = 09:00 AEST (next day) — call is rough for APAC; record detail.
- When Marcus speaks about rollbacks, ask: "what's our time to revert to amber baseline?" Need numbers: median + 95th.
- Keep eye on token-level cost metrics in dashboard during canary; ping CostOps if spike > 2x baseline.

Parking lot (non-blocking items to move to next sync):
- Longer-term: Instrumentation for quantized-model perf variance across batch sizes. Owner: Samir.
- Perf: Investigate small mem leak in runtime process that shows up after 48+ hours. Owner: Infra team.

Post-meeting follow-ups (I will do these and mark done):
- Upload time-stamped notes and decision log to Confluence under Weekly Release Train – Sep.
- Create small ticket for flaky auth tests (tag: qa + serving-runtime) — assign to Lena.
- Draft exec summary for Monday: 3 bullets on readiness, 1 blocker, proposed mitigation.

Quick personal checklist before I sign off tonight:
- confirm Lena smoke artifacts (Y/N)
- confirm canary cohort size and monitoring dashboards linked (Y/N)
- snapshot infra dry-run logs (Y/N)
- ensure rollback playbook end-to-end executed on staging (Y/N)

Comments and open questions (for meeting):
- Can we get a lightweight automation to validate comms recipient lists? (Noah)
- If the audit question stays red, do we have a clean separation plan for private customers that does not require code revert? (Marcus/Aisha)

Timestamped note: 2025-09-18 22:05 PT — quick check-in with Marcus: he thinks we can proceed with limited canary if infra patch lands before 23:30 PT. He asked me to be ready to trigger the canary ramp if smoke tests pass at 23:00 PT.

End of personal watchlist for tonight. Will update this doc after the sync with decisions and move to final version if all green.

-- Evelyn
